description: Returns project roles for the specified company.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of roles to return per page.

parameters.name: filters[users_only]
parameters.description: When true, return only roles of type contact.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project role.

add_to_project_team.description: Whether contacts holding this role on a project are listed in the Project Team section of Project Home. This is a display setting only; it does not assign anyone to a project.

deletable.description: Whether the role can be deleted. False when project role memberships exist.

display_on_company_home.description: Whether the role is shown on the company home page.

type.description: Whether the role applies to people (contact) or companies (vendor).

position.description: Sort order of the role within the company.
